name: PNG DataCo Caution Bay SEZ Data Centre
notes: PNG DataCo CEO Paul Komboi (Business Advantage PNG interview, 2026-02-05) states DataCo plans to build another data centre at Kumul Petroleum's special economic zone in Caution Bay (Central Province, near Port Moresby); Tech In Pacific repeats the plan. name: PNG DataCo Lae SEZ data centre (consideration)
notes: PNG DataCo CEO (Business Advantage PNG, 2026-02-05) says DataCo is looking at an SEZ zone in Lae (Morobe) to maintain data centres, alongside Caution Bay and Islands/Highlands regions. Early-stage site consideration only; no site, tender or capacity published.

name: Vodafone PNG Lae regional data centre
notes: APAC Outlook (2023-06-05) reported Vodafone PNG's main data centre is in Port Moresby and regional data centres would commence in Lae and later Mount Hagen; a Cybo/Google business listing ('Vodafone Data Centre-LAE', Montoro St, Lae) suggests a named Lae facility exists (C-grade directory evidence). No MW capacity or completion date published; kept as planned telecom regional data centre per methodology (roadshow/MoU/plans != operational).

name: Datec Sovereign AI Data Centre solutions roadshow - Lae

Promotional roadshow with no physical Lae data-centre facility or capacity confirmed; recorded as announced lead per methodology (roadshow/pre-launch = announced/planned).
